title: Questionable groups targeting women via UFO call-down events

tellings.quote: sense as a cover. Based on people I know and their interactions with some questionable groups out there, it seems like they're more interested in females.

plain: Matthew Brown, described as a Pentagon whistleblower, said on Jesse Michels's podcast that some questionable groups use UFO "call-down" events, gatherings meant to summon craft through meditation, as a cover. Based on what people he knows experienced with these groups, Brown says the groups seem more interested in women. If true, some groups in the UFO world would be using the subject to target women.
